# Appropriation Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2013

**Annual Budget of Local Government of Pitogo, Quezon for Fiscal Year 2014 — P54,612,468.42**

Resolution No. 129

## Summary

Enacts the Annual Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for Fiscal Year 2014, totaling **P54,612,468.42**. Introduced by Coun. [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Total Budget:** P54,612,468.42
- **Fiscal Year Coverage:** FY 2014
- **Legal Authority:** Enacted pursuant to Sections 305, 306, 314, 316, 318, and 447 of RA 7160

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
